text:
Mira: rolled the adaptive-throttle microbatcher to a 10% canary in prod this morning. quick summary: p95 down ~14%, p99 down ~27%, token cost down ~11%. logs + samples in the canary dashboard link.
Kai: whoa nice. is this the variant that backoffs aggressively for long-tail seqs?
Mira: yep — it uses seq-aware throttling + short-window burst smoothing. avoids stalling hot workers when a long request arrives, so we keep microbatches consistent.
Ellie: can you paste the canary numbers? want to add to the weekly runtime update.
Mira: sure — from the canary window (4h):
```
baseline p95: 210ms -> canary: 180ms (14% down)
baseline p99: 980ms -> canary: 720ms (26.5% down)
mean tokens/sec per GPU +12%
cost per 1M tokens -11.3%
error rate unchanged (0.03% -> 0.031%)
```
Raj: did we see any increased tail error or OOMs from larger batches now that throttling shifts traffic?
Mira: no OOMs. we added a protective upper-bound on dynamic batch size and a graceful soft-evict if KV cache memory pressure hits 85%.
Kai: rollout plan?
Mira: ramping 10->50->100 over next 48h if no regressions. auto-rollback if p99 increases >10% or error rate x3 for 15min. deploy-bot will post health checks.
deploy-bot: adaptive-throttle-canary deployed @ 2024-07-09T10:12:34Z to 10% of traffic. health-monitor enabled.
Ellie: any perf diffs by model size (L2 vs L4)?
Mira: L2 sees the biggest relative p99 win (~35%), L4 smaller (~12%) because L4 batches are already larger; but overall cost wins across shapes.
Raj: good to highlight that in the Optimize playbook — add quant recommendations for L4 + throttle combo.
Mira: noted. I'll open a short doc with canary graphs and a checklist for Dedicated customers (in case they want to opt-in early).
Kai: :thumbsup: can we get a quick A/B sample of generation quality? throttling shouldn't change outputs but want a smoke test.
Mira: ran 500 prompt pairs A/B; no statistically significant drift (per our eval harness). attaching eval gist in the dashboard.
Ellie: adding to weekly runtime wins post. nice work team :tada:
Mira: thanks all — will post final rollout status and open PR for the rollout config after 50% step.
__notes: This thread is a compact internal announcement about a runtime perf win (adaptive-throttle microbatcher). Messages are short, Slack-style, include a deploy-bot entry, metrics, code block, and rollout plan. All fields are strings or list of strings as required.
